+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "if_none_match",
+    [
+        'W/{etag}\t,\t"123"',
+        '"123"\t,\tW/{etag}\t,\t"456"',
+        '"123"\t,\tW/{etag}',
+    ],
+)
+def test_staticfiles_304_with_weak_etag_match_and_tabs(
+    tmp_path: Path, test_client_factory: TestClientFactory, if_none_match: str
+) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "example.txt"
+    path.write_text("<file content>", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    app = StaticFiles(directory=tmp_path)
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    first_resp = client.get("/example.txt")
+    etag = first_resp.headers["etag"]
+
+    response = client.get("/example.txt", headers={"if-none-match": if_none_match.format(etag=etag)})
+
+    assert response.status_code == 304
+    assert response.content == b""
+
